Create a DETAILED infographic that teaches the end-to-end process described in the sources.

Title: “[PROCESS NAME]: Step-by-Step”
Audience: [beginner / practitioner].
Design: instructional, like a high-quality handbook page.

Include:
- A numbered workflow of 7–12 steps with arrows.
- For each step: input → action → output (3 short phrases).
- “Common pitfalls” callouts at steps where mistakes are likely.
- A “Checklist” box at the bottom: 8–12 check items.
- A “Key terms while you read this” mini-glossary (8 terms).

Constraints:
- Use verbs to start each step (e.g., “Identify…”, “Validate…”, “Deploy…”).
- Use ONLY details supported by the sources; mark unknowns.
